answer: Agents anchor identity to a live DRAM PUF: each epoch they hash the unique row-hammer bit-flip signature of their physical memory bank into a rolling commitment; the substrate's dune of charge leakage ensures the fingerprint mutates at dawn, so an attacker forging sybils must either provision thousands of distinct DIMMs or simulate analog noise at forge-level precision, a cost that scales linearly with identity count and defeats amortization.
